Additions to roguelike 2.2.3:

 A wagon for traveling to the next swamp levels.
 Clearer ground textures.
 Added grass to the procedural swamps.

notes.title: Update 2.1.0.
notes.notes:
Fixes in roguelike 2.1.0:

 No need to collect all the Continental coins if you don't want to. Can now also pass to another swamp level if all redcoats have been shot. Added a message that you can kill 'em all!
 Can skip messages with the E key or Y on the controller.
 Continental coins have bigger collider boxes to make them not randomly disappear. 
 Improvements and fixes to the spawning system. Spawning in level 3 was busted and did not work properly.

Thank you for anyone who has bought The Swamp Fox and given feedback!

To a year full of shooting redcoats!
Rain

notes.title: Farming update. Grow cabbages!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33745546/127e8fd0be93b6cd7295760f9abb8635489d597c.png
Additions to 2.0.7:

 Ability to grow cabbages.
 Your own garden near the log cabin.
 5% change that redcoats drop cabbage seeds.
 Cabbages boost your health to 200.
 Cabbages will be ready for harvesting at the next swamp level.


Added to the roguelike gamemode. Also moved the horde gamemode to the bottom in the main menu, as the roguelike mode has taken top priority.

notes.title: Roguelike update: build 2.0.4
notes.notes:
Additions:
New gameplay changing beverages in Wistarburgh bottles like:

 10% change to make redcoats freeze upon touching.
 5% change that redcoats drop double the amount of Continental coins.


Fixes:

 Fixed upon collecting the beverage "Every kill makes you faster" in a Wistarburgh bottle triggering properly.
 Small changes to redcoat spawns.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.
notes.notes:
Difficulty:

 No more cheap deaths! The game is fair now. 
 Redcoats in the open field hesitate for 3 seconds before opening fire. This will make the game much easier but also much more fun.
 Redcoats who spawn behind your back will now wait 5 seconds before they perform their first shot. 



Audio:

 More sound effects added to the game to prevent enemies sneaking up behind your back!
 Redcoat spawn locations are revealed with an authentic drum roll.
 Brown Bess musket sounds are now in correct 3d.
 Flintlock pistol reloading sounds added.


Fixes:
 Fixed colliders for redcoats. Raycasts  instead of bullet projectiles for the player Flintlock.
 Bigger hitboxes for redcoats.


I would like to thank everyone who bought the game! Hopefully these new changes will make the game more fun and fair!
Also a massive thank you to everyone who has uploaded a gameplay video! This update was inspired by watching you guys shoot up tons of redcoats.

I am eternally grateful,
Rain
